Parse Hive DDL without recovery

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	tspack "github.com/xberg-io/tree-sitter-language-pack/packages/go"
)

func main() {
	config := tspack.ProcessConfig{
		Language: `sql`,
	}
	result, err := tspack.Process("CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE t(`a` string, `b` array<string>)\nPARTITIONED BY (`p` string)\nROW FORMAT SERDE 'org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.parquet.serde.ParquetHiveSerDe'\nSTORED AS INPUTFORMAT 'x' OUTPUTFORMAT 'y'\nLOCATION 's3://{{bucket}}/t/'\nTBLPROPERTIES ('k'='v');", config)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Language)
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Metrics.ErrorCount)
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Metrics.TotalBytes)
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Structure)
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Structure[0].Name)
}
```
